scope: Local read-only source, test-design and retained compiler-log review of the independent F-based prototype. Reviewer did not run builds or tests, access Oracle/router, or alter product code.

implementation.selection: Reuse the existing elapsed poll duration: at least 1 ms selects a per-listener limit of 1 true return; a shorter wait selects the existing limit of 16.
implementation.total_budget: The original shared budget of 16 step_udp true returns remains outside the listener loop in both modes.
implementation.mode_is_hint: Elapsed poll time includes scheduler suspension and EINTR retries. A queued or zero-timeout poll can still take at least 1 ms; high load is not guaranteed to select 16.

scheduling_and_error_review: The change limits repeated calls within a listener; existing fd readiness, initial-files and interface-admission gates remain intact.
When the limit ends a batch, unread kernel-queued datagrams remain eligible for the next level-triggered poll. No synthetic readiness or extra read was added.

False returns still end that listener's batch immediately. Oversize and Ok(None) invalidate resend state; WouldBlock/TimedOut preserve it; other receive errors including EINTR invalidate it, as before.

Short packets, QR packets, ACL rejection and accepted/deferred work still count as true returns. The budget does not count all receive attempts; consumed oversize and other false paths never decremented it and still do not.
TCP admission still runs once per listener even after UDP exhausts the shared budget. Upstream completions, TCP clients, DHCP, neighbors, deferred EDNS and TFTP retain their existing order afterward.
Shorter batches allow the existing service boundary to run earlier between queued DNS packets. No within-turn control/service ordering was moved.
The cooperative DHCP wait path still calls step_udp once per listener independently of this field.
No round-robin policy was introduced. Fixed listener order retains its existing fairness limits, including possible starvation beyond the shared budget.

resolved_finding.first_check: E0308: expected u64, found usize in counters.max_batch.max(batch). The new comparison with udp_batch_limit inferred batch as usize.
resolved_finding.review: The cast is safe for this counter because batch is bounded by the shared constant budget of 16. The correction does not change scheduling.

local_check.reported_by_coordinator: Local aarch64-unknown-linux-musl cargo all-target check passed after the counter cast correction.
local_check.directly_reviewed_evidence: The initial stderr contains E0308 and failed binary/binary-test compilation. The corrected stderr has no error diagnostic and ends with Finished dev profile [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 0.43s.
local_check.warnings: Compiler warnings remain in the retained logs; this is not a warning-free check.

receipt.provenance: Coordinator transcription of root exec_command result ccd66a, not an independently generated compiler receipt.

local_check.receipt_limit: Command and exit status are bound through the coordinator's tool-result transcription; stderr independently corroborates the successful compiler completion. No independent rerun or Linux runtime execution was performed.

test_design_review.name: udp_idle_batch_preserves_queued_packets_and_busy_budget
test_design_review.coverage: Real loopback sockets prequeue one first datagram plus 17 valid queries. Forced limits 1, 16, 1 verify retained work for a valid first packet, a two-byte invalid true-return packet and a 1233-byte oversize false-return packet.
test_design_review.determinism: No sleep or concurrent sender is used; modes are selected explicitly so scheduling delays cannot change the expected packet counts.
test_design_review.valid_packet_sentinel: first_length=0 selects a normal valid query; it is not a zero-length-datagram case.
uncovered_by_new_test: Actual elapsed-time selection at the 1 ms boundary; each selected field value is overwritten by the fixture.
Multiple listeners sharing the total budget or TCP/service progress in the same turn.
Injected receive errors, Ok(None), and the terminal WouldBlock diagnostic counter.
test_design_review.existing_source_contracts: The direct resend preservation/invalidation fixtures and step_udp implementation remain unchanged.
test_design_review.execution: Pending. The local cargo check compiles test targets but does not execute the new or existing Linux tests.

limitations: No runtime pass, SDK qualification or performance improvement is established by this source review and local cargo check.
Actual mode selection and the low-load/high-load tradeoff require separate measurement; the fixed read-one prototype's results do not transfer to this prototype.
F remains immutable, and this prototype does not change the accepted E baseline.
